source.citation: World Bank. The Global Findex Database 2025. Washington, DC: World Bank.

notes: Unlike what was the case in previous editions, data collection for The Global Findex 2025 gave priority to low- and middle-income economies. Data on mobile phone ownership, internet use, and account ownership were collected in all economies, but questions on financial use and financial health were asked only in low- and middle-income economies.
Demographic group data are only available for variables where the all-adult value is greater than 10%.
Sub-sample data are only available for variables where the all-adult value is greater than 10%. Demographic group data is not available for sub-samples.

In 2021, because of ongoing COVID-19 related restrictions, some economies were surveyed by phone in 2021 but face to face in 2017 and 2024. Please refer to the Global Findex Methodology for more information on this: https://www.worldbank.org/en/publication/globalfindex/methodology
